description: First Tri-Star Modaraba was formed under the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980, and is managed by A.R.T. Modaraba Management (Private) Limited. It is a perpetual Modaraba listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange and is primarily engaged in leasing and Ijarah of plant, machinery, motor vehicles — commercial and private — and computer equipment.
